svg.title: All actors and implemented use cases - final code baseline 5ff8076

g.text: All actors and implemented use cases - final code baseline 5ff8076
Manager can delete unreferenced accounts or archive referenced accounts.
Guarded restore leaves accounts inactive; active toggle is explicit.
Contact-profile updates are limited to first name, last name, and phone.
Employees login before protected use cases.
Customer access is QR exchange and HttpOnly grant.
